problems_addressed.specific_problem: Creating engaging content to attract clients

episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen shares insights on the impact of the pied-a-terre tax on New York's luxury market and the importance of having a strong opinion in real estate. She discusses her approach to creating engaging market reports and leveraging media presence to build a brand. Frances also highlights the discipline and consistency learned from her ballet career that she applies to real estate.
